claim: Grok paid plans use a shared weekly pool, but current community reports show incompatible depletion rates and cannot support a fixed prompt/token estimate.
scope: Reports published or posted around 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-01
qualifier: Different plan tiers and product features, no standardized logs or model mix.

claim: The discovered multi-provider apps expose personal usage/quota or local API spend, while no second publicly verified normalized crowd allowance dataset for these providers surfaced.

qualifier: Codex and Work surfaces are excluded; no Codex allowance values are cited.

claim: The Gemini community reports are individual, unnormalized experiences; one poster's plan is not stated and one commenter explicitly identifies Google AI Pro.

claim: Allowance visibility sources differ by data class: first-party provider meters, third-party account-reader claims, local estimates, API cost dashboards, and crowdsourced reports are not interchangeable; no normalized crowd dataset for the in-scope consumer chat plans was verified.
scope: Selected provider, app, API, tracker and homepage pages checked 2026-10-05
qualifier: AIRadar was not run; AI Usage Limit Alerts was not audited; TiboTattle evidence is homepage-only and has no reported Codex values.
